点击展开手动皮肤安装流程 Agent 先只读确认当前 Desktop 版本和其他已启用的皮肤；发现冲突时列出名称，指导你在应用中停用，并核对停用结果后再继续。拿不到启用状态时，应请你提供插件列表或界面状态，不能把“无法确认”当成“没有冲突”。

dsh-skin-market README · 从市场安装具体皮肤：安装目标使用面板给出的完整固定 spec。GitHub 目标保留完整 commit；monorepo 子包还要保留 `&path:/子目录`，例如 `github:owner/repo#<完整 commit>&path:/packages/skin`。没有 npm 包时，不要把该目标换成包名、`latest` 或仓库主分支。 Agent 每次只指导一项操作，等你反馈后继续：打开「插件 → 添加插件」、粘贴完整目标、确认安装结果、按提示启用，最后按当前版本要求完全退出并重新打开应用。Agent 不代点安装或启用，不执行 Desktop 安装命令，也不修改 profile。界面不支持该目标或安装失败时，先核对原始报错和维护者说明，再决定下一步；依赖伴生包的皮肤须核对完整安装要求。 这些说明不改变市场的 npm 一键安装流程，也不代表所有 GitHub 或子目录皮肤都已完成官方 Desktop 实机验收。

dsh-skin-market README · Web 页面异常时重置皮肤：如果皮肤冲突导致 DSH Web 页面无法操作，先停止当前 DSH Web 进程，再执行：

```bash
~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/.bin/dsh-skin-market-reset --profile web
```

这个命令会关闭皮肤市场管理的皮肤并恢复默认外观，但保留已安装的皮肤包和皮肤市场。随后重新启动 DSH Web。官方 Desktop 不要执行这个 Web profile 命令，请在应用插件管理器或市场中停用冲突皮肤。

text: dsh-skin-market README · Common problems and troubleshooting：First follow the specific reason shown in the market dialog or banner. Do not reinstall just because a package is already installed, and do not uninstall the entire profile just because one enabling attempt failed.

dsh-skin-market README · Common problems and troubleshooting：| Situation | What to do first |
| --- | --- |
| Network or download timeout | Retry once. If it continues to fail, copy the market diagnostic log and check the network and install source actually used by DSH. |
| Installed but not in use | Open the skin details and click “Use”. Check whether it shows “Restart required” or “Not taking effect” and read the reason. |
| Enable/disable overridden by another setting | Follow the component-specific instructions in the dialog; do not reinstall repeatedly. When the market can safely locate the override, it provides a direct repair entry point. |
| Installation blocked by new-package protection | Allow only the exact version named in the error, or wait for the protection period to end. Do not disable global protection. |
| Operation result is still being confirmed | Wait for the market to verify the result from DSH. Do not click Install, Enable, or Uninstall again. |
| The page cannot be operated because of a skin conflict | Stop the relevant DSH Web process, then use the Web reset command below. |
dsh-skin-market README · Common problems and troubleshooting：

dsh-skin-market README · Installation blocked by new-package protection：The market tries to merge exact-version exceptions already present in the current profile. If installation is still blocked, allow a version only after confirming that the package name and version came from this error. You can also wait for pnpm’s protection period to end. The market never disables protection for an entire package or for all future versions.
Need an Agent to help with a new-package protection error?

dsh-skin-market README · Installation blocked by new-package protection：```text
Please handle this DSH Desktop new-package protection error. First confirm the actual Desktop profile name and directory. From the ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION diagnostic, confirm the exact package name and version that was blocked; do not assume that the skin currently being installed is the blocked package.

dsh-skin-market README · Installation blocked by new-package protection：Only handle the minimumReleaseAgeExclude field in this profile’s pnpm-workspace.yaml. First merge versions already allowed by rules for the same package, while preserving other rules, comments, and the global age policy. If the exact version in the error does not already have an exception, show me the package name, version, and source, and add that exact version only after I confirm. Do not set minimumReleaseAge=0. Do not allow future versions of the entire package. Do not read .env, credentials, or other secret configuration. If a mixed configuration may contain secrets, first obtain narrowly scoped authorization to read the specified fields.
dsh-skin-market README · Installation blocked by new-package protection：</details>

dsh-skin-market README · Reset skins when the Web page is broken：If a skin conflict makes the DSH Web page unusable, stop the current DSH Web process first, then run:

```bash
~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/.bin/dsh-skin-market-reset --profile web
```

This command disables skins managed by Skin Market and restores the default appearance, while keeping the installed skin packages and Skin Market. Then restart DSH Web. Do not run this Web profile command for official Desktop. Disable the conflicting skin in the app’s plugin manager or in the market instead.

text: dsh-skin-market README · Online catalog：New skins and catalog information update independently; you do not need to upgrade the market plugin first:

dsh-skin-market README · Online catalog：- When the market opens, it reads the latest catalog. While the page remains open, it checks about every 5 minutes and checks again when it regains focus.
- The browser keeps the most recent valid catalog and prefers the cache when the network is unavailable.
- Search and sorting cover the full catalog, and the list loads in batches.
- Installation targets in the catalog are fixed to the version or complete commit recorded when the skin was accepted. The market checks the target and entry point before installation.
- Community skins are not a security endorsement from DSH or the market. Read the skin repository, license, and compatibility range before using one.

dsh-skin-market README · Submit your skin：If you develop a DSH skin, prepare a public GitHub repository and submit one `registry/skins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` file to this repository. The catalog entry contains submission information only; CI fills in the package, commit, loader ID, and preview image.

```yaml
url: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>
```

dsh-skin-market README · Submit your skin：For a monorepo subpackage, also add `subpath:`. YAML may contain only `url`, `subpath`, `name`, `author`, `description`, and `screenshots`. Do not write `package`, `rowId`, `category`, `tags`, or `install`. The generated catalog file `data/catalog.json` does not need to be maintained in a community PR.

Requirements:

dsh-skin-market README · Submit your skin：- It must be a public, installable DSH Web skin repository or monorepo subpackage.
- The install source must be fixed to a complete 40-character commit SHA.
- The repository or package metadata must provide the package, row ID, license, and DSH compatibility range.
- Preview images must be real screenshots of the interface from the repository.
- Acceptance is not security certification or official endorsement.

dsh-skin-market README · Submit your skin：Please complete the following steps:
1. Use read-only checks to confirm that the skin repository is a public GitHub repository (or a monorepo subdirectory) and is an installable DSH Web skin. Do not read .env, credentials, or chat history.
2. Fork or clone the target directory repository and create a new branch. Add only one YAML file under registry/skins. Do not overwrite existing entries or modify data/catalog.json.
3. The YAML must be a thin entry. Only url, subpath, name, author, description, and screenshots are allowed. Adding package, rowId, category, tags, modes, compatibility, install, or other fields will fail. CI fills in the remaining fields from the skin repository:
dsh-skin-market README · Submit your skin：url: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>

dsh-skin-market README · subpath: packages/my-skin   # only for a monorepo subpackage：4. Put preview images in screenshots.json or the README in the skin repository. Do not use SVG, data URI, or a third-party image host.
5. Do not write the full schema. If registry:check reports missing id/install, remove the extra fields and run it again; do not fill in the schema.
6. Run npm run registry:check in the root of the target directory repository. Do not install anything into my real DSH profile.
7. git diff --name-only must contain only registry/skins/<entry-file>.yml. Commit the change and create a PR in the target directory repository with the title feat(registry): add <skin-name>.
8. Return the PR link. If you do not have GitHub permission, only prepare the branch and copyable PR content.

dsh-skin-market README · Safety and boundaries：- The market installs only skin identifiers listed in the catalog. It does not accept arbitrary commands or installation addresses.
- The market does not log in to GitHub for you or silently create a PR. Whether to fork, commit, or create a PR is decided by you and the Agent’s actual actions.
- Community skins are not security certifications from DSH or the market. Before installing, review the skin repository, license, compatibility range, and source.

dsh-skin-market README · Local development：Node.js 22 or higher is required.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kingOfSoySauce/dsh-skin-market.git
cd dsh-skin-market
npm install
npm run dev

`npm run dev` starts a preview page using Mock Host data and does not modify any DSH profile.

When developing local catalog entries, you can make the market read the catalog bundled with the current build:

```sh
DSH_SKIN_MARKET_LOCAL_CATALOG=1 dsh web
```
